topic.angle: Why same potential means no current

body.question: A bird perches on a high-voltage power line and is not shocked. Why?
options: Its body and the wire are at the same electric potential, so no current passes through it
body.reveal: Current needs a voltage difference between two points to push it. Sitting on one wire, the bird is at the same potential as the wire. Lineworkers on a live line are safe for the same reason, and it is the same principle that lets birds sit on power lines.

probes.question: A lineworker safely holds a live wire when the worker and the wire are...
True or false: in an ohmic conductor, the current between two points is directly proportional to the voltage across them.

claims.claim: Bird and wire at same potential so no current passes through it
claims.quote: Because the worker and the work are at the same potential, no current flows through the worker.

claims.claim: Same principle lets birds sit on power lines
claims.quote: This is the same principle as that which allows birds to safely sit on power lines.
